notes: Primary contact: CTO - Mara Lin (wants deterministic citations).
Top priority: reliable agent-assist during Black Friday-like spikes; cannot degrade to unreadable hallucinations.
Requirements paraphrase: 'We need RAG that shows provenance, prefers fresh KB docs, and reduces agent clicks.'
KB sources: Zendesk tickets (10 years), Confluence product docs (multi-space), Google Drive attachments, internal PDFs.
Desired retrieval features: multi-source merging, freshness windowing (prefer docs < 90 days), citation snippets with links, per-result confidence score.
Tool-calling: agent UI must trigger create/update ticket calls (Zendesk API), escalate to supervisor workflow, and push suggested macros into UI via function-calls.
POC success metrics (proposed): 1) mean agent handle time reduction >= 18%, 2) citation accuracy > 85% on sampled prompts, 3) latency to first structured suggestion < 250ms under typical load.
Cost sensitivity: mid-high; willing to pay for private deployment and SLA but wants Optimize recommendations to reduce token spend.
Model preference: open/quantized models acceptable for majority of RAG answers; want ability to route sensitive queries to audited private model replicas.
Spike handling: want autoscaling + predictable throttles; fallback policies include route to cached KB answers, lower-cost model tier, and degrade non-critical features first.
Legal: legal team flagged on-prem license terms and data residency for EU customers; need template SOW for on-prem deployment.
Notes on integrators: Arcadian has in-house search infra (Elastic) but wants Redwood to provide managed vector store or connector to Elastic + Delta indexing.
Stated competitor evaluation: currently PoC with CloudContactAI; evaluating for better citation fidelity and lower per-session costs.
Request: provide sample pipeline for 'query -> retrieve (multi-source) -> rerank (freshness bias) -> cite -> render' with fallbacks illustrated.
Action items: SE to produce Confluence connector spec and estimated engineering effort; deliver security package (SOC2 + iso docs) to Arcadian legal.
technical_summary: POC scope: 14-day RAG proof-of-value. Inputs: Zendesk, Confluence, Drive, SQL product DB. Expectation: merged multi-source retrieval with per-chunk provenance, freshness TTL, and citation-first UI. Prefer VPC/private control plane with KMS. Need clear rollback and canary policy for model changes.
latency_targets: Agent-facing suggestions <250ms median; full summarization pipeline <1.2s under normal load; embedding lookup <50ms for cached vectors.
throughput_targets: Support org: 150 concurrent agents; peak burst handling up to 500 concurrent sessions during campaigns; target 20 reqs/sec per 100 agents peak.
sla_requirements: >=99.9% availability for critical agent paths; 15 min incident response for P1; longer RTO acceptable for offline batch operations.
poC_success_criteria: system sustains 3x normal peak for 30min with graceful degradation
commercial_notes: Prefers yearly reserved capacity if POC shows reliable economics; procurement needs SOW and pricing worksheet before Dec to hit Jan procurement window.
